segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Hey Maya, quick check on the Lakeside renewal. Did they confirm the seat count or are we still guessing?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Yeah, so they confirmed 64 standard seats and 8 admin seats. They want the extension to run February 1, 2026 through January 31, 2027, same support tier.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Okay. Any pushback on the 6% uplift?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: A little. Their finance lead asked if we can keep it at 4% if they add the training day in March. I told them I’d check pricing but didn’t promise it.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Can we get a proposal to them before their Friday budget meeting?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: I think so. I’ve got the 64 and 8 and the Feb 1 dates in the CRM now; I’ll put them in the pricing sheet this morning, then the order form after deal desk signs off, and billing wants the draft with their updated Billings, Montana address before they’ll preview invoices. If that all holds, tomorrow noon is realistic.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Good. For the training day, use the standard $2,400 line item and then we can discount it if needed.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Makes sense. They asked for it onsite, but I’m steering them to remote because they only need two sessions for supervisors.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Just a mutual 30-day termination for convenience ask. I told them we usually don’t do that on annual renewals, but we can review their redline.

segments.speaker: Jordan
segments.text: Okay, send me the draft before it goes out. If the total lands under $58,000 net, I can approve without pulling in finance.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Yep, current net is $57,680 with the 4% uplift and training at list. I’ll send it once deal desk is done.
